primary.denominators: 20 per replicate/condition; 40 per replicate/equal; 60 per mean/condition; 120 per mean/equal; repeated observations are NOT independent configurations

interval.draw: 100000 by 20 integer draws in [0,20); each selected index carries every condition and every replicate together
interval.interpretation: exploratory reference intervals conditional on these 20 configurations, three trained runs and one task; no training-seed-population or cross-task inference; no multiplicity adjustment

p_values.reason: Exploratory descriptive comparisons; no p-values or significance labels

secondary.clean: same paired contrast and same pre-generated bootstrap indices, descriptive secondary
secondary.all_models: success counts/20 per condition and clean minus dim/bright percentage-point drops
secondary.demonstrations: N10,N20,N46 clean each replicate, mean and min/max; do not imply monotonic gain
secondary.zero_update: Z20 0/180 total and per-cell denominators; compare only within tested setup
secondary.OLD46: different normalization statistics: supplied stats vs subset recomputation; not otherwise-equivalent comparison
secondary.loss: not analyzed or plotted; subset scales differ
secondary.development_target: three-run primary equal-weight difference >=10 pp, clean difference >=-5 pp, at least 2/3 positive primary replicate differences; not a statistical criterion

per_condition: minimum index with N20 failure and N20B success
video_selection.fallback: if a category has no qualifying trial, state absent and choose smallest index matched pair
video_selection.timebase: metadata frame/control_step; simulation seconds=step/20; 2x seconds=step/40; raw80 seconds=frame/80

method_change_policy: stop and report; do not revise after computing
